instruction: Wait on conditions, never on time; do not bypass Playwright's actionability checks
relevant_when: Test code waits for UI or network state, or performs click and input actions
context: Playwright auto-waits for actionability and web-first assertions retry. Fixed sleeps, networkidle waits and forced actions hide timing bugs and make suites slow or flaky. A committed .only silently disables the rest of the suite.

checklist.name: no-hard-waits
checklist.rule: No page.waitForTimeout(), sleep() or setTimeout-based delays are used to wait for UI state in specs or page objects
checklist.relevant_when: Code waits for the UI to update

checklist.name: no-legacy-waits
checklist.rule: waitForSelector(), page.$() and page.$$() are not used; a locator with an assertion or action replaces them

checklist.name: no-networkidle
checklist.rule: waitForLoadState('networkidle') and waitUntil: 'networkidle' are not used; the test waits for a user-visible element
checklist.relevant_when: Code waits for a page to finish loading

checklist.name: no-bypassed-actionability
checklist.rule: Neither { force: true } nor locator.evaluate(el => el.click()) is used to push through an obstruction; the obstruction is fixed or awaited (or a comment explains why a real click cannot work)
checklist.relevant_when: A click, fill or check action is performed

checklist.name: no-only-committed
checklist.rule: test.only and describe.only are not present in committed code
checklist.relevant_when: A spec file is added or changed
